# Fonts

- `roboto-*.woff2`: Roboto, Apache License 2.0, https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Roboto
- `jetbrains-mono.woff2`: JetBrains Mono, SIL Open Font License 1.1, https://www.jetbrains.com/lp/mono/

These files are vendored from `~/qrGenerator/vendor/fonts/` so the app has no external font requests.
